source.authority: The approved local landing, not the earlier compact Forma specimen.

sections.anatomy: Centered title, two actions, framed product preview, front/back halftone landscape
Four customer-mark slots and one supporting-evidence slot
Eight-column illustrative chart, four issue cards and closing statement
Four numbered steps with sticky desktop media and inline narrow media
Always-dark two-mode island, central phone preview and benefit columns
Six audience tabs and a matched example panel
Eight tool cards consolidate into six feature views
Four categories and native expandable answers
Three process steps beside a static form card

coverage.footer: Brand message, grouped links, terrain and final metadata row

specialCases: The two-mode section remains dark under both global themes.
The local source keeps a peach outer frame in dark mode because its body-descendant selector does not match.
The source contains branded media, automatic timed demos and mascot motion that are not automatically part of an original portable implementation.

implementation.ownership: Original implementation and neutral sample content maintained by Forma; observed measurements are not an authorship claim over the studied site.
adaptations: System-font fallbacks with explicit consumer font roles.
Original product and decorative media replace branded screenshots, mascot, logos and videos.
Static contact specimen with no submission, storage or success simulation.
Dark ground uses an intentional paired color rather than carrying the source selector defect.
Visual tabs, anchors and FAQ are presentation states; automatic source video, narration and mascot sequences are not claimed reproduced.

acceptance.compareAgainst: Frozen approved source, with font/content/artwork differences explicitly recorded.
